skill_name: Suggest a way to reduce plastic waste in society.
workflow: One of the most effective ways to reduce plastic waste in society is to increase public awareness and education about the negative impacts of single-use plastics. This can be done through campaigns and initiatives that emphasize sustainable, eco-friendly alternatives, such as reusable bags, bottles, and utensils.
